# What's Changed
- Featured, picked for you
  Titles like the ones you watch, what’s popular here and what’s new
- Know why a title is featured
  “Because you watched Dune”, “Popular here” or “New season”
- Featured respects your privacy
  Turn off personal recommendations and it stops using what you watch
- The same buttons everywhere
  On the web, watched and favorite look alike on home, people, books and music

- Seedy offers this version itself on phones and TVs (or update from Google Play).
- Update the Seedy plugin from Jellyfin's plugin catalogue, then restart Jellyfin: the web changes come with it.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/Arkmind/seedy/compare/v0.5.2...v0.5.3

# What's Changed
- See what you’ve watched
  A Watched chip with the date, or how far along you are in a show
- Play again or start over
  Replay what you’ve finished, or restart what you’re watching from the beginning
- Watched and favorite at a glance
  Their buttons fill in once they’re on, on the web, phone and TV
- Know when the next episode lands
  Shows you’re up to date on say when their next episode arrives

- On the web, Requests no longer shows the previous profile’s counts after switching profiles.

# What's Changed
- Sort and filter your history

- Steadier playback on weak Wi-Fi
  The phone and TV apps buffer further ahead and reconnect by themselves
- Request right away
  Your Seerr account is set up for you, no need to ask your admin
- Requested seasons show Ready
  As soon as the season is on the server, not once the whole show is

- Settings pages no longer jump sideways when you move between them.

# What's Changed
- Your screens answer only to you
  Other accounts, admins included, can no longer control your TV or computer
- Only your screens to control
  “Control a screen” lists the TVs and computers signed in to your account
- Each device’s Seedy version
  The admin shows which version of Seedy every phone, TV and browser runs
- See who needs to update
  Devices behind your server’s Seedy show “Update available”

## Good to know
- Admins keep Stop and Message on everyone's playback (Overview › Playing now). Every other control of someone else's screen is refused, from Jellyfin's own apps too.
- The "Control other users' sessions" and "Control shared devices" switches are gone from the user page: they no longer do anything.
- Two people sharing one account still control each other's screens: the server only knows accounts.

## Updating

- Update the Seedy plugin from Jellyfin's plugin catalogue, then restart the server: the rule on screens is enforced there.

## 🩹 Medu, back on its tentacles

Seedy 0.4.0 for Android closed the moment you opened it, on phones and on Android TV. Sorry about that! The part that checks your requests in the background lost a piece in the release build, so the app couldn't start at all.

### Fixed
- **The Android app opens again** on phones and Android TV, with everything 0.4.0 brought: Medu, request notifications, pull to refresh, the sleep-timer sheet and the TV screensaver.

### Updating
- Install the Android APK attached below over 0.4.0. Your servers and profiles are kept.
- Nothing changed in the Jellyfin plugin: updating it is optional.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Arkmind/seedy/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1

## 🪼 Meet Medu

Seedy has a mascot! Medu is a small moon jellyfish that grew out of the Seedy logo. A bit clumsy, never in a hurry, always glad to help. Medu drifts in whenever a screen has nothing else to show (a missing title, an empty list, a server that went quiet) and always comes with a plain sentence saying what happened and what to do next.

Six moods: waving hello 👋, lost with a torch 🔦, sleepy 💤, delighted ✨, thinking 💭 and, when something breaks, holding the unplugged cable 🔌.

### On the web
- **A proper 404.** The title swam off: Medu searches the deep sea between two giant 4s, with "While you're here" picks below. Hover Medu to say hi. Admins get the failed request to copy.
- **Can't reach your server.** Instead of a bare error, Medu shows which server, when it was last seen, and quietly tries again on its own until it's back.
- **Who's watching?** Medu waves you in, with colourful profile tiles, over the deep sea when the sign-in background is set to plain.
- **Empty pages that feel alive.** Favorites, History, playlists, My requests, and a brand new library while it's being scanned (admins see the progress).
- **Search.** When nothing matches, Medu checked every library for you and points you to Seerr.
- **Playback failed.** A clear dialog with what went wrong, "Try again", "Play another version" when there is one, and the technical details for the curious.
- **Ready to watch.** When something you requested lands on the server, Medu pops up with a button to start it.
- **Admin.** "First scan finished" on a brand new server, "All quiet" when nobody is watching, a toast when a backup finishes, and failed scheduled tasks shown up top.

### On Android phones
- **🔔 Request notifications.** Get notified when a request is approved and when it's ready to watch, listen to or read, with Medu cheering on the ready ones. Seedy checks every 15 minutes in the background. Turn it on or off in Settings with "A notification on this phone when something you asked for arrives".
- **Pull to refresh** on Home, with a tiny Medu.
- **"Medu fell asleep too."** When an audiobook's sleep timer ends: resume, add 15 minutes, or turn the timer off.
- Medu on sign-in, the server finder, the can't-reach-your-server screen and empty searches.

### On Android TV
- **Screensaver.** Leave the player paused for 3 minutes and Medu floats over a clock and what you were watching. Any button brings you back, still paused.
- Medu on Who's watching, empty searches, the server finder and the can't-reach-your-server screen, all fully usable with the remote.

### Updating
- Update the Seedy plugin from Jellyfin's plugin catalogue, then restart the server.
- Install the new Android APK attached below. On Android 13 and later, Seedy asks for permission to send notifications the first time you open Requests (never at launch).

Everything is in English and French. Have fun, and say hi to Medu 🪼

The first release of Seedy, a new web app for Jellyfin 12 shipped as a single plugin. Once it's installed, your server's address opens Seedy. Jellyfin's own web app moves to `/old`, and Jellyfin's mobile, TV and desktop apps keep working.

**Requires** Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Optional: Seerr (Jellyseerr / Overseerr) for requests, and a media segment provider such as Intro Skipper for the skip buttons.

### What's in it
- **Home that learns from each profile:** Featured titles with muted trailers, Continue watching, Next up, Top 10 this week, Because you watched…, genre rows, Latest in each library, Discover, Upcoming and Collections. The row order follows what each profile actually plays.
- **Search as you type:** results grouped by kind, a best match you can play at once, recent searches, browsing by genre, typo-tolerant matching, and Seerr results under the library's.
- **Requests through Seerr,** made as the signed-in person so their limits and auto-approval apply, plus My requests.
- **Live TV:** On now, a guide with a "now" line, channels, recordings and series rules, and a live player with channel up/down. Works with M3U (IPTV) and HDHomeRun tuners and XMLTV guides.
- **Player:** skip intro, recap and credits; chapters and seek previews; styled ASS/SSA and PGS subtitles; Up next, pause screen and end-of-movie picks; Watch together (SyncPlay); cast to other Jellyfin apps.
- **Play log,** behind the viewing history, the Top 10 and the home rows.
- **Personal settings** at `/settings`: profile and sign-in, home screen, playback, subtitles, display and controls.
- **Admin dashboard** at `/admin`, replacing Jellyfin's: branding, home screen, requests and play log; server settings, users, libraries, playback, networking and Live TV; devices and activity; plugins, scheduled tasks, backups (with a weekly automatic backup), logs and API keys.
- **English and French,** following the browser or each profile's choice.

### Install
In Jellyfin, add `https://arkmind.github.io/seedy/manifest.json` under **Dashboard › Plugins › Repositories**, install **Seedy** from the catalogue and restart Jellyfin. To keep Jellyfin's app at the server address, choose **Admin › Branding & playback › Where Seedy opens › Alongside Jellyfin**; Seedy then opens at `/seedy/`.

name: Seedy
description: A new web app for Jellyfin: a home screen that learns from each profile, Seerr requests, Live TV with a guide, a full admin dashboard and personal settings, in English and French. Replaces Jellyfin's web app at the server address (which moves to /old), or opens alongside it at /seedy.
overview: A new web app for Jellyfin, with Seerr requests and Live TV
